tha-ap526:1.1: Abbhañjanadāyaka.] Nāgare Bandhumatiyā rājuyyāne vasām' ahaṃ / dhammavādī tadā āsiṃ kamaṇḍaludharo ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap526:2.1: Addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sayambhuṃ aparājitaṃ / padhānapahitattan taṃ jhāyiṃ jhānarataṃ vasiṃ. // //
tha-ap526:3.1: Sabbakāmasamiddhiñ ca oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ / disvā pasanno sumano abbhañjanam adās ahaṃ // //
tha-ap526:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yam abbhañjanam adās ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi abbhañjanass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap526:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Abbhañjanadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
